title: High Cable Curl
summary: A curl with both arms out to the sides from high pulleys, hitting the biceps in the shortened position.

equipment_needs.text: Needs: cable station with an adjustable pulley.

muscles.why: Library rating 1 for biceps (main mover): each working set adds 1 of a set to the weekly biceps total.

setup.text: Stand between two high pulleys holding a handle in each hand, arms out at shoulder height.
Curl your hands toward your ears, keeping your elbows high.

form_cues.cue: Curl the handles toward your head
Keep your upper arms still. Only your forearms move.

mistakes.text: Dropping the elbows as you curl.

lower_risk.text: Warm-up: the app adds no ramp-up sets; make the first working set a touch lighter if you like.
The app suggests a heavier load only when the jump is 10% or less; otherwise it adds a rep first.
Default target: 10-15 reps, stopping about 2 reps short of failure (RIR 2). Stop the set when form breaks down.
Use the same controlled range on every rep; lower under control rather than dropping or bouncing.
Pick a variation and range you can train pain-free.

alternatives.why: Swap sheet: More stretch emphasis, Biceps long-head stretch, Less peak-contraction focus.
Swap sheet: More stretch emphasis, One side at a time, Less constant tension.
